entry.title: New: dsh-crew
entry.summary: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk. Exact install spec: dsh-crew. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
